items.prompt: Which of these is a sign of the noun?
options: It can take the article al-
It can take qad before it
It can take the sīn of the future
items.explanation: The article al-, tanwīn and khafḍ mark the noun; qad and the sīn of the future mark the verb.

items.prompt: What separates a noun from a verb?
options: A noun shows a meaning without tying it to a time
A noun always has three letters
A noun can never be the doer
items.explanation: The verb carries a time; the noun does not.
Kitābun has tanwīn, a sign of the noun. Kataba is a verb and qad a particle.
